value: NYMEX Crude and Refined Futures Volume Incentive Program (CL, HO, RB on Globex)
detail: Volume-incentive program for large participants in CL outright futures on Globex; predetermined volume thresholds; in force through 2021-2024 per the stated term. Applies to MCL and QM only as their leader's (CL) program.
quote: Crude Oil Futures (“CL”), NY Harbor ULSD Futures (“HO”), and RBOB Gasoline Futures (“RB”) that are traded on Globex® (“Products”). | Start date is February 1, 2018. End date is January 31, 2024 January 31, 2025.

value: NYMEX Crude Oil Incentive Program (CL and BZ on Globex)
detail: Liquidity-building incentive program covering CL outrights; participants unlimited; incentives on meeting requirements. Leader program for MCL and QM.
quote: Crude Oil Futures (“CL”) and Brent Last Day Financial Futures (“BZ”) that are traded on the CME Globex Platform (“Products”). | Start date is February 15, 2024. End date is August 31, 2024 January 31, 2025.

value: NYMEX Oil Incentive Program: does not cover CL (third-party-assessment crude products only)
detail: Scope is North American crude futures and options priced off a third-party assessment; CL (an exchange price) is not in scope by the stated definition. Recorded so the lead does not count it for CL.
quote: All North American crude oil futures and options products that incorporate a third-party price assessment as either the price of the contract or the price of the first leg of the contract (“Products”).
